result.note: Brief defence item; tested the complex's location and its link to the Sudarshan Chakra shield programme.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Advanced Weapon System Complex opened by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in June 2026:
items: The complex is located in Hyderabad.
The complex was tied to India's Sudarshan Chakra shield programme as part of its missile push after Operation Sindoor.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. Rajnath Singh opened the complex in Hyderabad on 15 June 2026, linking India's post-Operation Sindoor missile push to the Sudarshan Chakra shield programme.
questions.source: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh opened a new Advanced Weapon System Complex in Hyderabad, tying India's post-Operation Sindoor missile push to the Sudarshan Chakra shield programme.
